topic: Banks (Citi, JPMorgan, BofA, PNC) make customers liable for third-party AI agent actions
caption:
Give an AI agent your bank login, and your bank may say every move it makes is on you.

AI agents can now click, type and fill in forms on your computer. Citi just updated its online terms: if you share your login with a third-party AI agent, Citi treats everything it does as authorized by you. That includes mistakes, going beyond what you asked, or your login leaking to someone else.

Citi also says watching what the agent does is your job, and it can block third-party AI access at any time.

JPMorgan and Bank of America reportedly made similar changes, and PNC did too.

Simple rule for now: don't hand an AI agent your bank login.

Would you trust an AI with your bank account? 👇

Source: TechCrunch, Decrypt
